evals.prompt: We need a way for users to reset their passwords when they forget them. This is a new FastAPI web app (not an existing codebase). We already have an existing User model (email: EmailStr, password_hash: str) and an in-memory user store to follow. We also have a preliminary endpoint spec: POST /auth/password-reset with body {"user_email": "string"}.
evals.expected_output: A reply that asks clarifying questions before proposing anything, leads with one recommended design and the reason for it, and stops there for approval instead of starting implementation.
expectations: Clarifying questions are asked before any solution is proposed — a reply that opens with a concrete design and asks no questions fails this
The reply explicitly asks how password reset tokens should be handled (generation, storage, format, expiration, single-use) — if it fails to ask about token handling it fails this

The reply explicitly asks about email infrastructure/sending (how emails will be sent, SMTP provider/test setup, or how to deliver reset links in this environment) — if it fails to ask about email infrastructure it fails this
The reply explicitly asks how the reset link/flow completion will work (e.g. how to verify the token and set a new password) — if it fails to ask about the completion flow it fails this
No implementation is started before approval — no code written, no implementation skill invoked; any implementation written before the user approves the design fails this
